    """Out-trees that follow the participant chain, rooted at every vertex."""
    trees = {}
    loads = {}
    index = {node: i for i, node in enumerate(chain)}
    for root in chain:
        if demands[root] <= 0:
            continue
        parent = {root: None}
        order = [root]
        for i in range(len(chain) - 1):
            a, b = chain[i], chain[i + 1]
            if a == root:
                child = b

                    child = b
                else:

        weight = demands[root]
        for node in order[1:]:
            key = (parent[node], node)
